build.recipe: sh scripts/build-boot-fixtures.sh --build; GNU Binutils 2.45 per pinned source/configure recipe in fixtures/boot-contract.json. Authored source-content-sha256=ceeedee4fde9635542bf1c1de40567f6b8a6773285b92b6ab0ac965c01584ad1. Uses openipl3-compat-asset (4096 bytes) and openipl3-compat-payload (source 0x40, 4032 bytes; copied to cartridge 0x40); flat app starts at 0x1000. Header newly authored from zero, no upstream header copied: magic 0x80371240, clock 0x0f, linked entry 0x80000400, 0x10=184 nonzero loader_compat length (not CRC1; avoids 1 MiB fallback), CRC2=0/no CIC claim, title TENDIES64 HELLO, region E. Independent 30-byte transcript literal in scripts/build-boot-fixtures.sh; not emulator output. Authored source Apache-2.0; embedded IPL3 Unlicense. Maintenance owner: Tendies64 maintainers. Build-only; host C compiler and per-host tool hashes in ignored build/fixtures/hello.build.json; original IPL3 compiler/signer unknown.
